method: Read actual final native CID/GID/font/point/paint/Y/X and every complete original source graphical path inside each human-reviewed expression bounds. Declared motion is only a coordinate locator; actual final path geometry and actual final native text must independently match the original transformed by exactly that one dx. Original score/separate-display glyphs independently checked at exact original x/y. No PDF changes or threshold changes.
